items.title: Cisco IOS XR Software Vulnerability Allow Attacker to Execute Commands as Root
items.description: Cisco has issued a high-severity security advisory warning organizations about two critical privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in its IOS XR Software. If exploited, these flaws could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root or gain full administrative control over affected routing devices.
